# Cotisen Dental

> Cotisen Dental is a China-based dental supplies manufacturer with 16+ years of experience offering wholesale dental products, consumables, and specialized instruments for restorative dentistry and orthodontics.

The site features a comprehensive catalog of dental supplies including matrix systems, wedges, retractors, applicators, and isolation tools. Cotisen Dental specializes in both standard products and customizable OEM solutions for dental professionals and practices worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Dental Sectional Contoured Matrices Kits
- WedgeGuard
- Silicone Clearance Wedge
- Dental Wedge
- Silicone Dental Retractor
- Aligner Chewies
- Micro Applicator
- Retainer Retrievers
- Dental Dam Kit
- Adhesive Tip Applicator
- Matrix Band
- Clamping Ring
- Restorative Dentistry
- Orthodontic Accessories
- Dental Isolation Tools
